description: Wildland Fire Management covers the history of fighting and managing wildfire, its harms and benefits, prescribed fire, prevention, fire behavior, firefighter safety and tactics, hand tools, a hands-on fire readiness option, a major historical fire, and careers.

safety.note: Never start or approach a wildland fire. Tool demonstrations and field visits happen only with qualified fire professionals.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. This badge was added in 2026 and uses a digital resource guide instead of a printed pamphlet.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)
Wildland Fire Management Digital Resource Guide (scouting.org)

requirements.title: History
requirements.summary: The history of wildland fire suppression, prevention and management in the United States.

requirements.title: Harms of wildfire
requirements.summary: Effects on forest products, wildlife habitat, water, recreation, homes and air quality.

requirements.title: Benefits and prescribed fire
requirements.summary: How prescribed fire reduces fuel and restores ecosystems.

requirements.title: Prevention
requirements.summary: Causes of wildfire and the wildland–urban interface.

requirements.title: Fire behavior
requirements.summary: How weather, topography and fuel affect fire, and the parts of a wildfire.

requirements.title: Firefighter safety
requirements.summary: Protective equipment, the standard firefighting orders, watch-out situations and LCES.

requirements.title: Suppression tactics
requirements.summary: Direct and indirect attack and the Incident Command System.

requirements.title: Wildland tools
requirements.summary: Hand tools used in wildland firefighting and other firefighting equipment.

requirements.title: Fire readiness
requirements.summary: One option, such as a fire readiness plan, a Firewise assessment, or meeting a forestry, prevention or fire-weather professional.

requirements.title: A historic wildfire
requirements.summary: A catastrophic U.S. wildfire and how it changed policy.

requirements.title: Careers
requirements.summary: Researching a career in wildland fire.
